title: Halpern-Accelerated Majorized ADMM with Optimal Non-Ergodic Convergence under Degenerate Preconditioning
summary: We develop a Halpern-accelerated majorized alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) with possibly indefinite proximal terms for linearly constrained convex composite optimization. Majorization simplifies the subproblems but introduces a forward perturbation to the standard degenerate proximal point representation. We reformulate majorized ADMM as a perturbed degenerate proximal point method and characterize the fixed points of the induced mapping as Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) solutions.
